# CG-REQ-035: Request discriminator value removed

A discriminator mapping value of a request schema was removed.

**Why it matters:** A removed mapping value can no longer select a variant.

| Attribute | Value |
|---|---|
| Area | [Requests](./#req) |
| Direction | request |
| Detects | `schema.discriminatorMappingChanged` |
| Severity | breaking: high · potentially breaking: medium · undetermined: medium |
| Classification can be overridden | no (the rule only fires when the change is breaking by definition) |

## Message

> Discriminator values {values} are no longer accepted in {where}.
>
> Consumers sending a removed discriminator value will be rejected.
>
> **Fix:** Keep the mapping entries, or release as a new major version.

## Examples

Each example is an executed test case of the rule (`packages/engine/test/compat/fixtures.ts`).

### Fires: mapping value removed

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'}, {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Wallet'}], discriminator: {propertyName: kind, mapping: {card: '#/components/schemas/Card', wallet: '#/components/schemas/Wallet'}}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'}, {$ref: '#/components/schemas/Wallet'}], discriminator: {propertyName: kind, mapping: {card: '#/components/schemas/Card'}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
  components:
    schemas:
      Card: {type: object, properties: {kind: {type: string}}}
      Wallet: {type: object, properties: {kind: {type: string}}}
```

**Result:** Breaking, high. Discriminator values wallet are no longer accepted in POST /x: the request body (application/json).

### Does not fire: mapping added

```diff
  openapi: 3.1.0
  info: {title: t, version: v}
  paths:
    /x:
      post:
-       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'}], discriminator: {propertyName: kind}}}}}
+       requestBody: {content: {application/json: {schema: {oneOf: [{$ref: '#/components/schemas/Card'}], discriminator: {propertyName: kind, mapping: {card: '#/components/schemas/Card'}}}}}}
        responses: {'204': {description: ok}}
  components:
    schemas:
      Card: {type: object, properties: {kind: {type: string}}}
```

**Result:** no finding from this rule.
